content: where INLINEFORM0 is a hyperparameter that controls the contribution of individual constituents. This model leverages the average statistics computed over the training corpora (as encapsulated in the word and phrase vectors) to detect compositionality, and is the primary way compositionality has been evaluated previously BIBREF21 , BIBREF22 . Note that for the simple additive model INLINEFORM1 with unit-normalized word vectors, INLINEFORM2 is independent of INLINEFORM3 .
